h: FBI reportedly publishes names and photos of four Nigerians wanted over $6m email fraud
p: The FBI has reportedly released the names and photos of four Nigerians it wants in connection with a $6 million business email compromise scheme.
more: Separately, a Nigerian man has reportedly been declared wanted in the US over alleged $3.1m Medicare fraud.
